provenance: Written and labelled by the C4 author (single annotator) from the revised Bloom taxonomy: the label is the cognitive process the item asks for. Not independently annotated, so there is no Cohen's kappa; a second annotator is still required.
split_rule: Alternating items within each level: even positions dev, odd positions test. Cue lexicon changes are developed on dev only; test is scored after the lexicon is frozen. The `hard` split holds indirectly phrased items with no cue verb: it measures what a verb-cue matcher cannot do and is never used to tune the lexicon.
